{{Quote|I'm hit. Got my Artoo unit and punched a hole in my canopy&hellip;''"<br />"''Break off and return to base, Rogue Two.|Will Scotian and Luke Skywalker, during the Battle of Gall|<ref name="SOTE novel">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref>}}
'''Will Scotian''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] who hailed from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], where he grew up dreaming of becoming a hero and finding fortune among the [[Star/Legends|stars]] while watching [[Transport/Legends|transports]] take off from Brentaal's immense [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]]. Scotian learned to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] simple [[Skiff/Legends|cargo skiffs]] for a local freight hauler and apprenticed aboard [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighters]] before joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] as a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilot]]. Scotian loved pushing his fighter to the limit, which proved adventurous during his training. He registered an outstanding [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]] record while serving at the Rebellion's [[Oracle Base]] in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]] and later fought in the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]]. Scotian's excellent combat record soon convinced [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] to request his transfer into the elite [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]]. Scotian flew under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Rogue Two/Legends|Rogue Two]].

Scotian participated in Rogue [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron's]] failed mission to help [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] rescue the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-encased [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Gall/Legends|Gall]] in 3.5 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]. During the [[Battle of Gall]], Scotian and Rogue Squadron fought to hold off two [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyers]] and 144 [[TIE series/Legends|TIE starfighters]] while the Rebels sneaked into the [[Cadavine Sector Fleet Imperial Enclave|Imperial Enclave]] on Gall's surface in pursuit of Fett. Two [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]] badly damaged Scotian's [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]] early in the engagement, forcing him to evacuate the combat zone, while Fett eventually escaped with Solo.

By the [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], Scotian's service with Rogue Squadron had come to an end, although he experienced a short return to the squadron in [[7 ABY/Legends|7.5 ABY]], following the [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|liberation]] of the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] from [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] control. The [[Antilles's Rogues|regular members]] of Rogue Squadron had resigned their commissions in the New Republic to wage an unsanctioned [[Bacta War|war]] against the forces of de facto Imperial leader [[Ysanne Isard]], which prompted the New Republic to organize a temporary, ersatz Rogue Squadron, consisting of former squadron members, including Scotian, for morale purposes. Once Isard was defeated, the real Rogue Squadron returned to the New Republic, and Scotian returned to his previous unit.

==Biography==
{{Quote|Rogue Two, that's affirmative, lock and load.|Will Scotian|<ref name="SOTE novel" />}}
===Battle of Hoth and joining the Rogues===
Will Scotian, a [[Human/Legends|Human]]<ref name="CSWE-Scotian" /> [[Brentaalan|native]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] [[Brentaal IV/Legends|Brentaal IV]], grew up dreaming of becoming a hero. In his youth, Scotian often watched [[Transport/Legends|transports]] taking off from Brentaal's huge [[Spaceport/Legends|starport]], and, like many of his peers who did the same, he yearned to make a fortune out among the [[Star/Legends|stars]]. Scotian began his [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] career by learning to handle simple [[Skiff/Legends|cargo skiffs]] for a freight hauler near his home. Later, he apprenticed aboard [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighters]], one [[Standard day/Legends|day]] abandoning his job and jumping [[Starship/Legends|ship]] to join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] struggle in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].<ref name="SOTE Sourcebook" />

Scotian began training to pilot [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] while with the Rebel Alliance, which proved to be something of an adventure because of his brash nature. He enjoyed pushing his fighter to the limits and soon compiled an outstanding [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]] record while serving at the Rebellion's [[Oracle Base]] in the [[Brak sector/Legends|Brak sector]].<ref name="SOTE Sourcebook" /> Eventually, Scotian received a brief posting to [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base]],<ref name="Rogues Gallery">{{InsiderCite|146|Rogues Gallery|Rogues Gallery: Clearance for Immediate Launch}}</ref> the [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command's]] secret headquarters on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Water/Legends|ice]] planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]],<ref name="Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref> where he served with [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]] under the [[Callsign/Legends|call sign]] [[Blue Three/Legends|Blue Three]].<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> However, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] discovered Echo Base in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], forcing the Rebels to begin hastily abandoning their compromised Hoth outpost.<ref name="New Essential Chronology">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>

[[File:ScotianLeia-ESB.png|thumb|left|320px|Will Scotian and other Rebel pilots listen to Princess Leia Organa's briefing prior to the Battle of Hoth.]]
As the Rebels prepared to evacuate Echo Base in the face of imminent Imperial invasion,<ref name="ESB" /> Scotian attended [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa's]] pre-battle briefing with a group of fellow [[Rebel pilot/Legends|pilots]] from [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Flight]], Blue [[Squadron/Legends|Squadron]], and [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]].<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> Leaning over the top of an [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter's]] [[KX9 laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]], Scotian listened as Organa explained that<ref name="ESB" /> Echo Base's pilots had the responsibility of either piloting or flying fighter escort for the Rebels' [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]] through the waiting Imperial [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] in Hoth's [[Orbit/Legends|orbit]] under the protection of the base's powerful [[V-150 Planet Defender/Legends|v-150 Planet Defender]] [[Ion cannon/Legends|ion cannon]].<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> Although the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] proved to be the Rebellion's worst battlefield defeat of the war,<ref name="CSWE-Hoth">{{CSWECite|II|62|Hoth, Battle of}}</ref> in which forty-two pilots [[Death/Legends|died]]<ref name="Who's Who">{{InsiderCite|74|Who's Who in Echo Base: The Unsung Rebels of the Battle of Hoth}}</ref> and seventeen of the Rebels' thirty evacuation transports were lost,<ref name="Warfare" /> the majority of base personnel safely escaped the planet.<ref name="Who's Who" /> Scotian himself survived as well.<ref name="Rogues Gallery" />

Following the Rebel defeat at Hoth, Scotian soon earned a position with the elite Rogue Squadron, whose pilots had covered Echo Base's evacuation. Scotian's stellar combat record at Oracle Base caught the attention of [[Rogue Leader/Legends|Rogue Leader]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], who requested the young pilot be transferred into the squadron, which continued to serve the [[Alliance Fleet/Legends|Alliance Fleet]] as a rapid response team in the [[Standard month/Legends|months]] following Hoth. Scotian flew under the call sign [[Rogue Two/Legends|Rogue Two]],<ref name="SOTE Sourcebook" /> the eventual successor of former Rogue pilot [[Zev Senesca/Legends|Zev Senesca]], who died during the Battle of Hoth.<ref name="CSWE-Senesca">{{CSWECite|III|138|Senesca, Zev}}</ref> Scotian's self-confidence in his abilities helped him fit in well with the Rogues. He learned much from his fellow pilots, but his brashness still tended to result in reckless and unconventional maneuvers.<ref name="SOTE Sourcebook" />

===To rescue Han Solo from Gall===
{{Quote|Hey, I can still shoot and I got manual.''"<br />"''Negative, Will, there's too many for that. Take a walk.''"<br />"''Copy, Rogue Leader. Rogue Two returning to base. Good luck, guys! I'll put the kettle on for tea.|Luke Skywalker denies Will Scotian's request to continue fighting during the Battle of Gall|<ref name="SOTE novel" />}}
In 3.5 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire]]'' to [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]].</ref> Scotian and the Rogues sneaked into the [[Zhar system]] of the Outer Rim Territories to set up a small temporary [[Rebel base (Kile)|command base]] on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] of [[Kile]],<ref name="SOTE Sourcebook" /> as part of a mission to help [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], Leia Organa, and [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] rescue the [[Carbonite/Legends|carbonite]]-frozen [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] from the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]]. The Rebellion had learned that Fett was holding Solo at the [[Cadavine Sector Fleet Imperial Enclave|Imperial Enclave]] on the nearby moon of [[Gall/Legends|Gall]], in preparation for delivery to the [[Crime lord/Legends|crime lord]] [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]. Scotian and the Rogues planned to attack the [[Imperial Enclave]]'s [[Imperial Navy/Legends|naval forces]] in orbit over Gall, which they hoped would create enough of a distraction to allow Organa and Calrissian in the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], and the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Dash Rendar/Legends|Dash Rendar]], piloting his [[YT-2400 light freighter/Legends|ship]], the [[Outrider/Legends|''Outrider'']], to sneak in and free Solo.<ref name="SOTE novel" />

[[File:BattleofGall-SOTE.png|thumb|right|225px|Rogue Squadron fights during the Battle of Gall.]]
Scotian and the Rogues were on hand in their [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighters]] to welcome the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} arrival in the Zhar [[Star system/Legends|system]]. They escorted Organa, Calrissian, and Skywalker, the latter flying his own X-wing, to the Rebels' moon base on Kile, where the group prepared for their upcoming rescue mission. Despite Skywalker joining Rogue Squadron as the unit's thirteenth member, flying as honorary Rogue Leader, the Rebels were vastly outnumbered. Scotian's squadron was required to keep occupied two<ref name="SOTE novel" /> [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyers]]<ref name="Imperial II-class">The two [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyers]] participating in the [[Battle of Gall]], as depicted in [[Shadows of the Empire 2|''Shadows of the Empire'' 2]], can be identified as [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyers]] based on the visual details of their three primary [[Destroyer-I ion engine/Legends|thrust nozzles]]. These [[Engine/Legends|thrust nozzles]] visually correspond to those found aboard the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Avenger/Legends|''Avenger'']] (seen [[:File:WhoWillTicketVaderForLittering-ESB.jpg|here]] and [http://theforce.net/swtc/Pix/Xbrooklyn/Isd31.jpg here]), which is confirmed to be an ''Imperial II''-class by ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'', as opposed to those found aboard the Star Destroyer [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']]), which is confirmed to be an [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] by ''[[Vader: The Ultimate Guide]]''.</ref> and their combined complement of 144 [[TIE series/Legends|TIE starfighters]]. During the ensuing [[Battle of Gall]], Scotian was forced to quickly evacuate the area after Rogue Squadron met the first wave of attacking [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighters]]. Two TIEs had maneuvered into pursuit of Scotian's X-wing, and though [[Rogue Six/Legends|Rogue Six]], [[Wes Janson/Legends|Wes Janson]], warned him of the threat, Scotian suffered [[Laser/Legends|laser]] damage to his fighter's [[Unidentified R2 unit (Will Scotian)|R2 unit]] and overhead canopy.<ref name="SOTE novel" />

Scotian was able to patch his canopy's leak and resolved to continue fighting, claiming he still maintained manual and weaponry control on his fighter, but Skywalker nevertheless ordered him to return to the Rogues' base on Kile. There were simply too many enemy fighters to risk Scotian's continued presence. Scotian left what turned out to be a failed mission for the Rebellion. Rogue Squadron held off the bulk of the Imperial Enclave's [[Navy/Legends|naval]] forces, despite losing [[Rogue Five/Legends|Rogue Five]], [[Dix Rivan]], in the process, but Organa and Calrissian failed to rescue Solo from Fett, who escaped Gall with his carbonite-encased [[Prisoner/Legends|prisoner]].<ref name="SOTE novel" />

In the days following the Gall mission, Rogue Squadron abandoned its base on Kile and returned to the Alliance Fleet. No sooner had the Rogues arrived, however, than they received a message requesting their assistance to help Skywalker, Organa, and Calrissian escape from the clutches of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] crime syndicate on the Imperial [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]].<ref name="SOTE Sourcebook" /> Rogue Squadron engaged both Imperial and Black Sun forces in a [[Battle over Coruscant|three-way battle]] in orbit over Coruscant, in which Skywalker and party escaped, and Black Sun suffered a crippling defeat.<ref name="SOTE novel" />

===An ersatz Rogue Squadron===
{{Quote|It's not ersatz. Just sort of auxiliary. For morale purposes, the Alliance needed a visible Rogue Squadron&hellip;We brought in some Rogue Squadron veterans&mdash;Riemann, Scotian&hellip;|Derek "Hobbie" Klivian|<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />}}
Scotian survived to see the Rebel Alliance's eventual transition into the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], following the massive Imperial defeat at the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" /> in [[4 ABY/Legends|4 ABY]],<ref name="New Essential Chronology" /> although at some point his service with Rogue Squadron came to an end. Scotian returned to Rogue Squadron<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" /> in [[7 ABY/Legends|7.5 ABY]],<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" /><ref name="New Essential Chronology" /> albeit in a temporary role, following the New Republic's defeat of de facto Imperial ruler [[Ysanne Isard]] and the resulting [[Liberation of Coruscant (Galactic Civil War)|Liberation of Coruscant]] from Imperial control. The [[Antilles's Rogues|official members]] of Rogue Squadron had resigned their commissions with the New Republic and their positions in the squadron to wage an unsanctioned civilian [[Bacta War|campaign]] to defeat Isard, who had escaped from Coruscant, once and for all. In the true Rogue Squadron's absence, the New Republic cobbled together an ersatz Rogue Squadron, consisting of former squadron members, for appearance's sake to maintain morale. Among those brought back was Scotian.<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />

Following the final defeat of Isard, the real Rogue Squadron accepted an offer to return to the New Republic with their positions reinstated, leaving the temporary Rogue Squadron members, including Scotian, to return to their original units. The ersatz Rogue Squadron escorted the real Rogues through the skies of Coruscant upon their triumphant return to the New Republic capital. In one last show of bravado before disbandment, Scotian and his squadron engaged the real Rogue Squadron in a friendly competition of precision flying that wowed the [[Coruscanti/Legends|Coruscanti]] crowds who had gathered to welcome back the returning unit.<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />

[[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Derek Klivian/Legends|Derek "Hobbie" Klivian]], the temporary Rogue Squadron's [[Commanding officer/Legends|commanding officer]], provided Wedge Antilles with the personnel files of his temporary unit for inspection before it was disbanded. Antilles was in the infancy stage of creating a new starfighter&ndash;[[Commando/Legends|commando]] unit, eventually named [[Wraith Squadron]], although Scotian was not selected for inclusion.<ref name="X-Wing: Wraith Squadron" />

Will Scotian was not related to [[Pedna Scotian]],<ref name="CSWE-Scotian" /> a [[Chev]] pilot who later served with Rogue Squadron during the New Republic [[Hunt for Zsinj|campaign]] to defeat rogue Imperial [[Warlord/Legends|Warlord]] [[Zsinj]],<ref name="X-Wing: Solo Command">''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]''</ref> circa 7.5 ABY.<ref name="New Essential Chronology" />

==Personality and traits==
Growing up watching starships depart from the large spaceport on Brentaal IV, Will Scotian always dreamed of finding adventure and fortune among the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|spacelanes]]. He received his chance after joining the Rebel Alliance as a starfighter pilot. His starfighter training was a bit adventurous, since Scotian enjoyed pushing his craft to its limit, but he nevertheless demonstrated excellence in combat. Scotian's exceptional abilities earned him a position with the elite Rogue Squadron, where his [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]]-sure personality helped him fit in well with his fellow pilots.<ref name="SOTE Sourcebook" />

If there was ever a fault in Scotian's combat abilities, it was that he was overaggressive and often had to be ordered to withdraw from a combat zone, even if his starfighter was badly damaged,<ref name="SOTE Sourcebook" /> such being the case during the Battle of Gall.<ref name="SOTE novel" /> Scotian would never willingly leave a battle, believing he was invincible and that heroism in a crippled starfighter was just part of his job description.<ref name="SOTE Sourcebook" /> Scotian had [[Color/Legends|brown]] [[Hair/Legends|hair]] and light skin.<ref name="ESB" />

==Skills and abilities==
Scotian commanded knowledge of planetary systems, street survival, and starfighter tactics. He also possessed [[Technician/Legends|mechanical ability]] in [[Astrogation/Legends|astrogation]], [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] operation, [[Realspace/Legends|space]] transports, X-wing starfighter piloting, and starship [[Gunner/Legends|gunnery]].<ref name="SOTE Sourcebook" />

==Equipment==
Scotian's equipment during his Rogue Squadron career circa 3.5 ABY included a [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistol]], [[Comlink/Legends|comlink]], and his [[Rebel flight suit]].<ref name="SOTE Sourcebook" /> He similarly donned a [[Flight suit/Legends|flight suit]] during the Battle of Hoth.<ref name="ESB" />

==Behind the scenes==
===Character development===
The character "Will" first appeared in the [[May]] [[1996]] novel [[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Shadows of the Empire'']], by [[Steve Perry]], in which he is one of two Rogue Squadron pilots downed during the Rebel Alliance mission to rescue Han Solo from Boba Fett on Gall.<ref name="SOTE novel" /> The character was provided a last name, "Scotian," and a brief background history to complement his involvement in the novel in the subsequent [[June]] 1996 ''[[Shadows of the Empire Sourcebook]]'', by [[Peter M. Schweighofer|Peter Schweighofer]].<ref name="SOTE Sourcebook" />

The [[December]] [[2013]] [[Rogues Gallery (department)|''Rogues Gallery'']] department from [[Star Wars Insider 146|''Star Wars Insider'' 146]] later established Scotian as being one of the Echo Base Rebel pilots present during Princess Leia Organa's Battle of Hoth briefing in the [[1980]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="Rogues Gallery" /> The film is therefore now [[Retroactive continuity|retroactively]] considered to be the character's first appearance in ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[canon]].<ref name="ESB" />

===Relationship to Pedna Scotian===
A character named Pedna Scotian, also a Rogue Squadron pilot, appears in the [[February]] [[1999]] novel ''[[X-Wing: Solo Command]]'', by [[Aaron Allston]].<ref name="X-Wing: Solo Command" /> ''[[The Complete Star Wars Encyclopedia]]'', released in [[2008]], confirms that there is no familial relationship between Will Scotian and Pedna.<ref name="CSWE-Scotian" />

Allston envisioned that Will Scotian helped rescue Pedna, a Chev [[Slavery/Legends|slave]], during a Rebel Alliance raid on mercenaries supporting the Empire in his post-Rogue Squadron days.<ref name="Allston FAQ" /> Recognizing the Human cultural trend of having two names, Pedna, who did not know her own family or clan name, adopted the surname "Scotian" in honor of her rescuer. Months after Will Scotian was transferred back to his unit after serving in the temporary Rogue Squadron during the events of Allston's novel ''[[X-Wing: Wraith Squadron]]'', Pedna Scotian was likewise transferred into Rogue Squadron, but no one knew if her assignment was because of her flying skills or some sort of administrative error, such as someone believing he was actually transferring Will Scotian into the squadron. Nevertheless, these events simply reflect Allston's personal backstory for the characters and have never been officially included in ''Star Wars'' canon.<ref name="Allston FAQ">{{WebCite|url=http://www.aaronallston.com/factpages/faq_starwars.html|text=Frequently Asked Questions: ''Star Wars'' Novels|work=[[Aaron Allston]]'s [https://web.archive.org/web/20150201124617/http://www.aaronallston.com official website]|archivedate=20150102092638|nolive=1}}</ref>
